sentences.text: Shri Santosh Chawala, Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Romil Verma, Government Advocate for the non-a
 Order

After arguing for a while, learned counsel for the applicant seeks leave of this Court to withdraw present bail application filed by the applicant u/S 439 of Cr.P.C./483 of BNSS, in connection with FIR/Crime No.51/2021 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station GRP, District Indore for commission of offence punishable u/S 376, 306 and 376(D) of IPC alongwith 3/6 of the POCSO Act.
Accordingly, present bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.
